entities.name: ATTACH ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by MME to UE when attach request is accepted. Contains various information elements including GUTI, TAI list, EPS network feature support, and ESM messages.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate attach procedure. Contains UE network capability, ESM message container, and other IEs.

entities.name: Timer T3450
entities.description: Timer started by MME when sending ATTACH ACCEPT message. Stopped when ATTACH COMPLETE is received.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: State entered by UE and MME after successful attach procedure completion.

entities.name: GUTI
entities.description: Globally Unique Temporary Identity assigned by MME to UE. Included in ATTACH ACCEPT when reallocated.

entities.name: ESM message container
entities.description: IE containing ESM messages like ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST or ESM DUMMY MESSAGE.

entities.name: EPS network feature support
entities.description: IE in ATTACH ACCEPT indicating network support for various features like EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection, control plane CIoT EPS optimization, etc.

entities.name: UE radio capability information deletion
entities.description: MME deletes stored UE radio capability information or UE radio capability ID when attach is accepted.

entities.name: TAI list
entities.description: List of tracking areas assigned to UE in ATTACH ACCEPT. UE replaces old TAI list with new one.

entities.name: ATTACH COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to confirm successful attach. Contains ESM message container with responses.

relations.description: MME starts timer T3450 when sending ATTACH ACCEPT message.
ATTACH ACCEPT may contain a new GUTI when reallocated by MME.
ATTACH ACCEPT contains assigned TAI list for the UE.
ATTACH ACCEPT contains ESM message container with ESM messages.
ATTACH ACCEPT contains EPS network feature support IE indicating supported features.
MME stops timer T3450 upon receiving ATTACH COMPLETE message.
MME enters EMM-REGISTERED state upon receiving ATTACH COMPLETE.
When attach is accepted, MME deletes stored UE radio capability information.
ATTACH ACCEPT is sent by MME in response to ATTACH REQUEST when accepted.
UE sends ATTACH COMPLETE in response to ATTACH ACCEPT.
